text.title: Miqra according to the Masorah
text.edition: Digital edition of the Tanakh based on the Aleppo Codex and related manuscripts

he.note: Tanakh: Miqra according to the Masorah text with the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible morphology aligned per word by the Biblia app’s build (scripts/build-tanakh.mjs).

text.title: The Greek New Testament: SBL Edition
text.publisher: Society of Biblical Literature / Logos Bible Software, 2010

el.note: Greek New Testament: the SBL edition with MorphGNT’s analysis per word, as the Biblia app’s build (scripts/build-gnt.mjs) carries them.

parsing: None of the Biblia app’s parsing code is used here. The per-word morphology columns are passed to the Go analysers (adapter-he, adapter-el) as the sources’ own readings; the card, the period decision and the Variants tab are GoLearn’s.
